summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for StaffingConsole DEEP panels + StaffOnboarding in EN/FR/DE for owner@isodemo.com. Logged in via cookie-dismiss + credentials, navigated /dashboard -> Operations -> Staffing, clicked through every top staffing-tab (dashboard, people, rota, timeclock, performance, payroll, expenses, comms, operations, rules) and every subtab discovered (people: hr, onboarding, orgchart, team-access, site-access; rota: rota, templates, leave, market, live, ai-rota; timeclock; performance: performance, ai; comms: announce, comms). For each tab/subtab in each of the 3 languages, ran regex scan for /staffing\.(sc_|onb_)[a-z0-9_]+/ on document.body.innerText. Total ~80 tab-visits scanned.
critical_code_review_comments: CSP violation warnings for external analytics scripts (assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflare beacon) are logged as console errors on every page load. Non-blocking for UX but noisy; consider CSP allowlist or removing the analytics tags.
Language switch works via localStorage.i18nextLng reload. In-app header language selector (FR/DE/EN globe) also visible and functional per screenshots.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123!  (dismiss 'Accept All' cookie banner first)
context_for_next_testing_agent: To repeat scan: login, /dashboard, click Staffing top-tab, iterate data-testid=staffing-tab-* and staffing-subtab-*, then evaluate regex on document.body.innerText. Set localStorage.i18nextLng to 'fr'|'de'|'en' + reload to switch language. No raw keys detected in this run across EN/FR/DE for sc_* or onb_* namespaces.
